hashConvention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 LF text and exact parsed Pester It command extents.

selectors.selector: rejects an actual writable registry path before any driver download
selectors.protects: a registry controlled by a non-admin cannot select an executable.
selectors.detects: dropping both protected path checks before opening the registry.
selectors.needs: Windows TestDrive ACLs and inert package fields. All external effects are mocked.
selectors.breadcrumb: Resolve-DriverInstallRegistry calls Assert-DriverInstallTrustPath before Get-DriverRegistry reads.

selectors.selector: rejects an actual junction in the trusted registry path
selectors.protects: a real path cannot escape the trust boundary through a junction.
selectors.detects: dropping the reparse-point check or opening the registry first.
selectors.needs: Windows NTFS TestDrive, inert target directory and one temporary junction.
selectors.breadcrumb: Assert-DriverInstallTrustPath rejects file and ancestor ReparsePoint attributes.

selectors.selector: selects one registry for the batch <Mode> path
selectors.protects: the version scan, shared-group mapping and actual install use one effective registry.
selectors.detects: scanning the bundled registry before switching to the machine trust registry.
selectors.needs: disposable copy of the batch entrypoint and an inert PC-AI.Drivers module in a child pwsh.
selectors.breadcrumb: Update-Drivers.ps1 resolves -ForInstall before Phase 1 and reuses the returned registry in Phase 2.
